environment.description: AWS Lambda function running as part of a Step Functions Express workflow. The Lambda execution role has `dynamodb:GetItem`, `dynamodb:PutItem`, and `dynamodb:Query` on the `tenant-documents` table with NO condition keys restricting access. The Step Functions state machine accepts arbitrary JSON input from an API Gateway endpoint with no input validation or JSONPath filtering. The DOCUMENT_ENC_KEY environment variable is set to a static value shared across all tenant workloads. No VTL request mapping template validation on the API Gateway integration.
